en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large medieval brick city gate with two round towers and a central arched passageway for traffic. A street with early 20th‑century vehicles and people passes through the gate. The structure is surrounded by railings and trees. Red printed French text appears at the top left identifying the subject, and a publisher credit is printed at the bottom left.
